references.text: Jesus predicts persecution of the disciples, which is relevant to the context in Matthew 10:23 where Jesus instructs them to flee from persecution.
Persecution of God's servants, reflecting the situation the disciples would face as described in Matthew 10:23.
God's judgment on Israel, which can be related to Jesus' warning that the disciples will not finish going through all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
The early church's experience with persecution and how they spread out, reflecting Jesus' instructions to flee from persecution.
Paul flees from persecution in Damascus, an example of following Jesus' advice in Matthew 10:23.
